items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: They were calling it, they, they, everything that wasn't good is what they called us. Clangy.

ctx.x: I forget where we were. Where's with the musical rubes? That's right. Yeah. That's right.

Well, how'd that come about? Well, uh, That was out of New York? That was in New York, yes. Uh-huh. So they, you see, the uniform originated in Chicago at the Lambs, so that musical rubes. Oh, yeah, to dress up and... Oh, sure, sure. They figured that they put a lot of corn shocks and a haystack and all of that. They, they figured that, uh, making rubes out of us was the proper thing in the big city. So, they started there. And they didn't call it musical rubes, they called it Brown Band from Dixieland. But then,…
